fields.Parcel #: Lot 128, Block 1253 on the official Tax Map of the CITY OF CAMDEN.
fields.Property Note:
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
*Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances Made by Plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether 01' not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee or the Mortgagee's attorney.
** *If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.Subject to tax sale certificate #26-01807 for sewer in the amount of $318.24. Third Party Purchaser is responsible for obtaining final amount to redeem.
